metadata.source_title: Evolution and Selection of Quantitative Traits

blocks.content: As noted for univariate cases, approximating the individual fitness function by a quadratic can give a very distorted view of the true fitness surface (Figure 29.10). We expect this distortion to be even greater in a multivariate setting. With this caveat in mind, quadratic fitness surfaces are still quite useful.
